title: Text: Mike Smith ↔ Anthony Fenech
snippet: I’m rapidly coming around. Most of their coin flips have come up heads. They have plenty of guys who can round out a rotation and I can see the makings of the position players: LF Stewart, CF Cameron,
searchText: i’m rapidly coming around. most of their coin flips have come up heads. they have plenty of guys who can round out a rotation and i can see the makings of the position players: lf stewart, cf cameron, rf fa, 3b candelario, ss castro or perez, 2b paredes, 1b fa, ca rogers, dh cabrera. even their extras are panning out, like woodrow.  mike smith
